notes.title: Update & XP Ultra
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a rather long time since I've been able to do an update on things and I'm here with two purposes: give you a bit of an update on what's going on and tell you a bit about a new program we are starting up at DreadXP.

[h2]Mortuary Assistant Console Release & Definitive[/h2]
First! The Mortuary Assistant is seeing a console release happening very soon. I wish I could give solid dates but so much depends on the certification process through console partners before you actually know. All I can say is that all consoles partners have the build and as soon as they approve it, I will give you all a date!

The version launching will be the Definitive Edition and it will be going live here on Steam at the same time. Definitive includes a number of stability improvements, bug fixing, lore, new haunting events, embalming only, and more. Mainly, Definitive is the version of Mortuary Assistant that I am most happy laying to rest so I may move on to new projects.

Owners of the PC version will get Definitive for free as will Switch players who already own the current port of MA on it.

[h2]Paranormal Activity[/h2]
This is my current project and still has a long way to go in development. Since I'm working directly with Paramount, there is a bit of red tape I need to go through before I can start sharing my work the way I have in the past with streams and various social posts. However, I will work to be able to start sharing progress as soon as I'm able.

[h1]XP Ultra & FLATHEAD[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/b05473dfe3c2ed9dc04edfb72f8bc4dac60d6f41.png[/img]
[b]FLATHEAD[/b] is the first title launched under our new XP Ultra program. For those that don't know, I am now the co-director of DreadXP and the Ultra program is something that means a great deal to me. It's designed to give games that may normally be overlooked by publishers a chance to receive support they may not normally get. We wanted to keep the spirit of the DreadX collections alive without the issues they brought on behind the scenes (they were a lot of work and demanding for all involved usually resulting in crunch)

Think of XP Ultra games as a single game from the collections but amplified. Ultra games are small and experimental with compelling gameplay mechanics, weird concepts, and short play times (1-2 hours)

I feel FLATHEAD is a perfect embodiment of what we are looking to do with XP Ultra and I had the pleasure of working directly with the developer Tim Oxton (creator of Silkbulb Test) to work out the kinks on game design and help him bring his idea to finish. As a developer myself, I wish there was a program like this when I was first starting out in the indie space and I really hope it brings something valuable to the indie horror space. Please give Flathead a wish list and grab it on Thursday!

-Brian

notes.title: A Post-Launch Update
notes.content:
[i][h3]Hey everyone![/h3] [/i]
It’s been a very eventful month since launching [i][b]The Mortuary Assistant[/b][/i] and I’ve tried my best to stay on top of as many bugs as possible. It’s a never ending battle but I’ll keep pushing to make everyone’s experience in MA [i]as smooth as possible[/i]!

Bug fixing is an eternal battle though so it will be taking a seat alongside new work I’m exploring for the game. I wanted to take a moment to share with everyone my plans for the near future of [i][b]The Mortuary Assistant[/b][/i]. I’m passionate about supporting my creations beyond launch so please have a look at what I have in store for future launch support. These changes will [i]not necessarily[/i] be in this order but they are all on the post-launch roadmap.
[hr][/hr]
[h3][i][b]Bug fixing[/b][/i][/h3]
Bugs will [i]always[/i] be a constant. There’s no avoiding it. I will always do my best to keep on top of fixes while creating new content and larger improvements.

[h3][i][b]Performance improvements / Lower-end computer support[/b][/i][/h3]
I know the game runs well on a number of machines but there are others who experience crashes or freezes that I want to address. I’ve noticed a number of the complaints are on lower system specs than recommended but I still want to work on more granular graphics settings and other tasks to try and get MA working for as many people as possible.

[h3][i][b]Steam Deck Support[/b][/i][/h3]
This is a [i]smaller[/i] goal that I will probably be working on later once I actually get my hands on a deck. I’ve done some work already but obviously want to have the device in my hands testing before I’m confident.

[h3][i][b]Non-Story mode, Bodies, and Lore Update[/b][/i][/h3]
I will be pushing out a handful of new bodies in the near future with some additional lore for people to find. I will also be adding a mode that does not run story events for those who have seen it all and simply want a “[b][i]night in the life of Rebecca[/i][/b]” style mode.

[h3][b][i]Localization[/i][/b][/h3]
I've been asked about localization a lot and it will be happening. This is something I need to get through with my publisher and it's simply been a busy time for everyone with all the conventions going on that they are traveling to. ([i]I will be going to PAX West myself soon[/i]) once this round of conventions is all done with, it will much easier to start hammering out details.

[h3][i][b]Larger Bodies and Content Update[/b][/i][/h3]
I am going to try and push for a more major content update for Halloween. I can’t promise it, but I want to do as much as I can. The goal is to provide a number of new bodies as well as a new ending. If it can’t make it for Halloween, it will come shortly after.

[h3][i][b]Embalming Only Mode[/b][/i][/h3]
This is a larger task as the embalming system is rooted pretty heavily into the haunt system. I will need to lift it and build a new base. I am uncertain yet if this will be an inexpensive DLC or a free update depending on the work-load to do it and the level of content I pour into it. Knowing me, I will probably end up wanting to expand some things. I don’t like creating new systems without amping them up so we’ll see.

[h3][i][b]New Story[/b][/i][/h3]
In the more distant future, I plan on building a new set of story elements into the game. They may be from a new protagonist, from Raymond, or something else entirely. I’m not certain yet. But long-term, I plan to provide additional story experiences to the game to further flesh out the universe and give everyone something new and fun to check out. 
[hr][/hr]
So that’s what I have planned moving forward. Obviously, MA [i]will continue to grow[/i] and I will take care of it for as long as everyone wants to keep playing it ([i]and probably longer because I’m a loser like that![/i])

I will also be slowly taking on other work soon ([i]all pretty exciting stuff that I hope I can share in the near future[/i]) as well as starting to toy with new project ideas in a few months.

I wanted to thank each and every one of you for your support and playing the game. It means [i]a whole lot to me[/i] to see everyone enjoying it and it’s beyond anything a single developer could have hoped for.

I know I’m not extremely vocal on the community boards at the moment but believe me when I say I read them [i]all[/i] and am working to fix everything I see! It would just be a massive time sink to interact with [i]every[/i] post made. So I apologize, but know that you are heard and I am working hard to address everyone’s issues, hopes, and concerns.

Thank you again and have fun keeping those demons at bay!

[b][i]-Brian[/i][/b]

notes.title: Pre-Launch Update 7-31-22
notes.content:
[h1]IT'S ALMOST TIME[/h1]

So I'm posting this today on the first but I made the video yesterday so I'm back dating it. I just wanted to take a moment to give some information on what I've been doing and working on in the final moments before launch.

I also cover what I plan to do post-launch (after a much needed break) Thank you so much for your support and I hope you have a great time playing The Mortuary Assistant!

[previewyoutube=q0srvZoiAHo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The short, short version[/h2]

[list]
[*] I'm working only on polish items and bugs
[*] The game is basically going to sit and stew while I play it over and over to make sure it's smooth
[*] I've been working on the game for 2 years so I will be taking a bit of a break but not from support. I will be addressing all the issues I can day one and beyond.
[/list]

[h2]The Future Plans[/h2]
[list]
[*] Console porting. I am working with my publisher to port to console after launch. What consoles are not yet nailed down but it will happen.
[*] Localization is coming. I originally wanted to have multiple languages on launch but there is a lot of dialogue in MA and I also wanted to support localized UI so I created a text system that supports (hopefully) easy localization. So while the original launch is English only, more languages will follow.
[*] Embalming Only mode is something I have wanted to add but is a larger task so I will be working on that in the coming months.
[*] Spooks Only mode. The story mode stuff gives a great experience but I know some would eventually like to just embalm, deal with all the generated spooks and banish demons so I will be working on that shortly after launch.
[/list]

There's more general work I will be addressing but this is the basic idea. It's all covered in the video. Thank you so much for your support and I hope you have a ton of fun in River Fields tomorrow

[h3]LAUNCH August 2nd
7am PST[/h3]

Take care all!

-Brian

notes.title: Developer Update #3
notes.content:
It's been a while since an update! I've been very busy with my move but I'm starting to settle in a bit and have gotten to do some exciting new work on The Mortuary Assistant. If you watch the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/darkstonedigital]TWITCH STREAMS[/url] then you have gotten to see some of the new work firsthand. Here's what I've been up to.

[h3]The Banish Tablet [/h3](temporary name)

The banish tablet is the physical representation of the goal for the player in MA. From the start, the player has needed to identify what demonic entity is present in the mortuary and what body it is tied to. The banish tablet is a system that embodies that goal.

The player will build the tablet based off of their experiences in the game. Every demon has a house and a manifest. (These are the aspects of the demon that will appear in the game) So for example: if you experience a LOT of fire along with sad events, the demon is probably from the house of Sorrow with the manifestation of fire. This information will lead you to the demons name. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/4b49a556b2332028c36a970e66e1380af19425b6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/7acda7928e82d329e30e848cf8cf7e63c762c555.jpg[/img][/url]

The tablet is a clay carving with various parts that can be inserted into it representing these houses, manifests, and sigils (demon names). Once this tablet is built and you believe you know what body the demon is possessing. Place the tablet on the body (locking the demon to its vessel) and burn it in the retort to send it back to hell.

[previewyoutube=pS7nMQi2S4k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Character Models[/h3]

I wasn't happy with the quality of the character model for Rebecca so I decided to re-make her along with creating Raymond Delver (the Mortician you work under)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/77c3848d53de1c70ace8e8a84bfb548b8b226b63.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/ca7e43d266741ad433586247555aafd16d256ba3.png[/img]

I then worked on adding the new Rebecca into the game and getting her hooked up into the same systems as the previous model. Still needs a tiny bit of work but I'm pleased with the results!

[previewyoutube=5WtxKHhI6fg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Talisman[/h3]

The Talisman is a system I'm still working on but it ties into the lose state of the game of becoming possessed. Throughout the embalming processes, events will happen around you that will contribute to your possession level. The talisman will be an item that will absorb some demonic energy to keep you from slipping into full possession. If it breaks, or you don't have one on you, events will have a much stronger affect on you.

These systems are still being worked on and I plan to have a discord chat with [url=https://www.patreon.com/DarkStoneDigital]Patrons[/url] today and get some feedback. Lots of awesome stuff to come! Now that these systems are getting completed, I get to start making content and that's when the game starts to come together! Until the next update.

-Brian

notes.content:
Development has been going smoothly for The Mortuary Assistant. If you have been hanging out in the daily dev streams over on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/darkstonedigital]Twitch[/url], you have seen a good deal of what has been getting done.

Mainly, I have been working on a lot of the back bone of the game. Systems that don't appear to do much on the surface but are hubs for all the vents that will be taking place within the game. I'm very excited for where I'm at currently as the real fun will start soon!

[h2]The Embalming Process[/h2]

One of the things that most players of the prototype were intrigued by was the embalming process. The main loop during the game will be the processing of 3 bodies where the player will be handling the preparation and embalming.

Obviously, I have taken many liberties with this process as I want it to stay fun and engaging but I am working hard to maintain the spirit of the process while focusing on the game's direction as a whole.

I have stood up the base framework for the entire process and am now drilling deeper into it. This will be one of the primary duties of the player so I want to make sure it feels engaging.

[previewyoutube=S7PnE5S30Nc;full][/previewyoutube]

Part of the workload for myself has been finding way to keep things moving quickly. Hey! I've bounced around from various blog platforms with my dev logs but I am settling on the steam community hubs per project. So keep checking back here to see updates on development!

[h2]EARLY PHASE[/h2]

There has been a lot of work done over the past few months and I really should have had an update a bit earlier.

I've been working on the design document ([url=https://www.patreon.com/DarkStoneDigital]available on Patreon[/url]) and roughing out the environment for the project. The mortuary base building is complete though it needs all it's... well, everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/6416f197f783f0885474e33c627f909506981b94.gif[/img]

[h2]SPOOKY SYSTEMS[/h2]

Anyone watching the development streams on twitch knows that I've been doing a lot of code the past week or so. I've been hard at work on building the systems needed to actually make the game happen. 

There is a VERY long way to go but I have built the basics of what I now call the "haunt" system which gives me the ability to do spooky things to you! Think of it like making my own lego set for me to play with later.

I've also been building the inventory. It's not very pretty but it's functional and allows me to continue other aspects of development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/1ac448b033c2d1f4c74eec70046a22ad298cf9d0.png[/img]

A re-work of the old lady from the prototype. While the prototype was a generated model, all the models in the full version will be hand sculpted by me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/4ae3c08523c96e62f637cad24f4b541f11e00762.gif[/img]

I really enjoyed how the water shader made everything feel outside and it was the first hint at atmosphere being added to the game. That's why I made a little mood video a while back.

[previewyoutube=_GkKquZq8-0;full][/previewyoutube]

That's it for this update! There has been a LOT of work but if I were to cover it all, this thing would be wayyy too long. Thank you so much for reading and keep an eye out for the next update!
